cohort: 180 antenatal women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies.
finding: A cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) cut-off of <=1.1 demonstrates superior predictive accuracy for adverse perinatal outcomes compared to the conventional cut-off of <1.
mod_finding: The CPR <=1.1 cut-off showed stronger associations with operative deliveries and a higher incidence of emergency caesarean sections for fetal distress.
cross-section timing: Doppler ultrasonography was performed at 37-42 weeks gestation.
birth_weight: Not an inclusion criterion, but birth weight was measured as an outcome.
